question: What is the attendance requirement to sit in the Major exam?
answer:
According to the current attendance policy, a student is expected to have full attendance in each course unless they take a leave of absence for valid medical or bonafide reasons. In any case, the attendance of a student should not fall below 75% in a course. However, the student will be allowed to appear for the exams even if their attendance falls below 75%. Students not meeting the attendance criterion of 75% will be required to score at least a C grade to pass a course.

Source: Circular 51: Amendment in the Attendance Policy, pp. 1-2

question: I missed my minor exam of CSL7650 because I was ill. What is the rule for a make-up exam? Also write an email to the instructor asking for a make-up exam.
answer:
The rule for a make-up exam is as follows:

* A student who has missed a minor or major examination due to genuine reasons like illness can be permitted to write a make-up examination for the missed components.
* The student should make an application to the Dean (Academics) through the course instructor within ten days from the date of the missed examination, explaining the reasons for their absence.
* Applications received after this period need not be entertained.
* The permission to take a make-up examination will be given under exceptional circumstances such as admission to a hospital due to illness.
* A student needs to produce the necessary document subject to one of the following categories:
	+ Students residing in the Hostels should produce a Medical Certificate issued by the Medical Officer of the Institute that he/she was admitted in the Hospital during the period of the missed quiz/exam.
	+ Students residing in the Hostels and taking medical consultation with outside Doctors are required to obtain written permission from the Medical Officer of the Institute Hospital before they proceed for such consultation.
	+ Students residing in the hostels but taking medical consultation with outside Doctors are required to obtain an endorsement on the certificate of treatment by the Medical Officer of the Institute Hospital.
	+ A student staying outside the Campus permanently / temporarily must produce a medical certificate from the Registered Medical Practitioner and the same should be duly endorsed by the parent/guardian.

Source: [Academic Regulations (web page) | 2026 | page 1]

Now, let's draft an email to the instructor asking for a make-up exam:

Subject: Request for Make-up Exam for CSL7650

Dear [Instructor's Name],

I am writing to request a make-up exam for the minor exam of CSL7650 that I missed due to illness. I was admitted to the hospital during the period of the missed quiz/exam and have attached a medical certificate issued by the Medical Officer of the Institute.

I would like to request a make-up exam for the missed minor exam as soon as possible. Please let me know the date and time of the make-up exam and any other necessary details.

Thank you for your understanding and support.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

Please note that you should attach the medical certificate to the email and make sure to include the instructor's name and your name in the email.
